newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka leads Latvian shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka leads Latvian shares higher.

text.p: Latvian shares were pulled up again on Wednesday by Unibanka as it extended gains following Monday's auction of one million of the state's shares in the bank.
The bourse index rose 1.35 percent to 388.22 while the Rietumu index added 1.12 percent to 152.12. Trade was a sluggish 68,000 lats.
Two of the official list stocks gained, two eased and two held steady.
Unibanka led the way as it climbed almost three percent to 3.36 lats in trade of 31,400 lats.
Dealers said it would gain further now that the auction, which saw its shares go for 3.22 lats, was over.
"Its real price is closer to 3.50 lats," said one broker.
Dealers said Unibanka, which also produced solid first half results, could attract much needed liquidity to the struggling market and boost other shares.
The market has been bitten hard by the bears of summer and competition from the local debt market and privatisation vouchers, which are regarded as better investment bets.
